meta.name: add-whatsapp-cloud
meta.description: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK. Official Meta API.

copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 NanoClaw 的 src/channels/,追加一行自注册 import,安装 @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0,再跑构建和注册测试,让项目能通过 Meta 官方接口收发 WhatsApp 一对一消息。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Meta 官方 WhatsApp Business Cloud API 通道时触发;若正在跑 /setup,可在配置流程中接入,之后用 /manage-channels 把通道绑到某个 agent group。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp Cloud API 通道接进来
say.note: 复制适配器文件并追加注册 import

say.text: 把我的 Phone Number ID 和访问令牌写进 .env
say.note: 依次询问四个值并写入环境变量

say.text: 跑一下 whatsapp-cloud 的注册测试
say.note: vitest 检查通道是否已注册

howto.what_en: Adds the WhatsApp Cloud adapter to NanoClaw: it copies the adapter files from the channels branch, appends the self-registration import to the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0, then runs the build and the registration test.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add Meta's official WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel to NanoClaw, or while running /setup to wire the channel up.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud API channel to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and appends the import

say_en.text: Store my Phone Number ID and access token in .env
say_en.note: Prompts for four values and writes them
